canada.title: In new memoir, Harper says he offered Carney a job — but not finance minister
canada.summary: Former prime minister Stephen Harper says he offered Mark Carney, then the governor of the Bank of Canada, a role in his Conservative government in 2012 — though not as finance minister. Not right away, at least.

canada.title: How a New Brunswick island is caught in the middle of the Canada-U.S. trade war
canada.summary: A Canadian island reliant on the U.S. for everyday necessities is caught in the middle as tensions strain a centuries-old relationship.

canada.title: Record number of 9 departing Winnipeg councillors eligible for a combined total of about $525K in severance
canada.summary: As nine new city councillors are set to take the oath of office Tuesday, the City of Winnipeg is set to pay out severance to a record number of departing council members after last week's civic election.

canada.title: First Nation in Manitoba's Interlake reclaiming its Cree language identity through lessons
canada.summary: Students from nursery to Grade 6 in Fisher River are taking Cree classes every other day of the week, in a push to improve fluency. Most adults in the community, located in Manitoba's Interlake, can't speak the language.

canada.title: Holt wants to help grow N.B.'s defence sector amid historic federal spending surge
canada.summary: The New Brunswick government has released a strategy aimed at boosting economic activity in the defence sector, with Premier Susan Holt hoping to see defence-related activity in the province increase by 31 per cent by 2030.

canada.title: Man wearing Nazi uniform while kids went trick-or-treating was 'disturbing,' woman says
canada.summary: A woman out trick-or-treating with her children on Halloween says she was disturbed to see a man wearing a full Nazi uniform on a residential street in Cole Harbour, N.S.

canada.title: Rally to support survivor of intimate partner violence held in Pugwash
canada.summary: People packed a community hall in Pugwash, N.S., on Sunday to show support for a woman who was viciously attacked by her former partner.

canada.title: After consistent increases since 2021, admissions to N.W.T. jails shot up this year
canada.summary: The number of admissions to jails in the N.W.T. took a dramatic jump in the past year, increasing by over a third.

canada.title: Charities look to ensure no child goes without Christmas magic, but demand is high
canada.summary: As Christmas inches closer, the organizers of two local holiday programs that fulfill wish lists for struggling families worry about making it a merry time of year for all.

canada.title: N.L. nurses turn to court to halt nurses’ union revote, confirm earlier election results
canada.summary: Three nurses, including one voted in as president of the province's Registered Nurses' Union, want the courts to stop a planned revote for later this month and confirm the earlier election results.

canada.title: ‘Active incident’: Shelter-in-place order issued at University of Toronto Mississauga campus
canada.summary: The University of Toronto has issued a shelter-in-place order for its Mississauga campus as Peel police respond to what they are calling an “active incident.”

canada.title: Saskatoon committee to weigh expropriating land for BRT stations
canada.summary: The leader of a Saskatoon business association says her members were taken by surprise that expropriation is on the table for the construction of six bus rapid transit sites.
